name: Ginger

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, may increase Pitta

folk_wisdom: Traditionally used in many cultures as a warming digestive support.
safety_notes: Generally safe in culinary amounts.

rituals.title: Warming Ginger Infusion
rituals.description: Traditionally used to warm the body and support digestion.
rituals.instructions: Steep 3-5 thin slices of fresh ginger in hot water for 10 minutes.

name: Peppermint

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic), especially cooling for Pitta

folk_wisdom: Known for its refreshing aroma and traditional use in soothing digestive discomfort.
safety_notes: Avoid if you have severe acid reflux.

rituals.title: Refreshing Temple Ritual
rituals.description: Combine the scent of peppermint with gentle pressure for a mid-day refresh.
rituals.instructions: Inhale the scent of fresh peppermint while gently massaging the temples in circular motions.

name: Turmeric

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Kapha, may increase Vata and Pitta if used in excess

folk_wisdom: A cornerstone of Ayurvedic wellness, traditionally used for vitality and joint comfort.
safety_notes: May stain surfaces and clothing.

rituals.title: Golden Milk Ritual
rituals.description: A traditional evening ritual for grounding and vitality.
rituals.instructions: Whisk 1/2 tsp turmeric into 1 cup of warm plant-based milk with a pinch of black pepper.

name: Chamomile

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: One of the most beloved herbs in European folk tradition for evening relaxation.
safety_notes: Avoid if you have a known allergy to ragweed or the Asteraceae family.

rituals.title: Starlight Steep
rituals.description: A gentle ritual to signal the transition to rest.
rituals.instructions: Steep 1 tbsp of dried chamomile flowers in hot water for 5 minutes before bed.

name: Cinnamon

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Traditionally associated with warmth, abundance, and digestive fire.
safety_notes: Cassia cinnamon contains coumarin; Ceylon (true) cinnamon is preferred for regular use.

rituals.title: Solar Vitality Brew
rituals.description: Cinnamon is ruled by the Sun and is traditionally used to support inner warmth.
rituals.instructions: Add a cinnamon stick to your morning tea or coffee to invite solar energy into your day.

name: Honey

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Kapha, may increase Pitta and Vata if old

folk_wisdom: Universal sweetener and base for traditional syrups; used for soothing the throat.
safety_notes: Do not give to children under 1 year old.

rituals.title: Sweet Intention Spoon
rituals.description: A ritual to start the day with sweetness and clarity.
rituals.instructions: Take a teaspoon of raw honey, let it dissolve slowly in the mouth while setting a positive intention.

name: Lemon

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Used globally for cleansing rituals and digestive support.
safety_notes: High acidity may affect tooth enamel if consumed in large amounts.

rituals.title: Morning Cleansing Water
rituals.description: A simple ritual to awaken the digestive system.
rituals.instructions: Squeeze half a fresh lemon into a glass of warm water. Sip first thing in the morning.

name: Garlic

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Known as the 'Poor Man's Treacle', historically used for protection and vitality.
safety_notes: Can cause strong breath and body odor; may cause digestive upset if raw.

rituals.title: Vitality Broth
rituals.description: A traditional winter ritual for seasonal resilience.
rituals.instructions: Simmer 3 crushed garlic cloves in a vegetable broth. Consume slowly during cold months.

name: Lavender

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Vata

folk_wisdom: Beloved for its calming aroma and used in sleep rituals for centuries.
safety_notes: Generally safe, but some people may have sensitivities to the essential oil.

rituals.title: Dreamweaving Sachet
rituals.description: A traditional practice to support restful sleep.
rituals.instructions: Place dried lavender flowers in a small cloth bag and keep it under your pillow.

name: Rosemary

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: The herb of 'Remembrance'; historically used to support focus and mental clarity.
safety_notes: Use sparingly in pregnancy (culinary amounts are fine).

rituals.title: Focus Smoke/Steam
rituals.description: A ritual to clear the mind before study or creative work.
rituals.instructions: Add a sprig of fresh rosemary to a bowl of hot water. Inhale the steam for 2 minutes.

name: Thyme

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Symbol of courage; traditionally used for seasonal support and respiratory comfort.
safety_notes: Avoid excessive amounts in pregnancy.

rituals.title: Courageous Steam
rituals.description: A ritual to clear the air and bolster inner strength.
rituals.instructions: Place fresh thyme in a bowl of steaming water. Inhale deeply while visualizing yourself overcoming a challenge.

name: Basil

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Known as the 'King of Herbs'; used for protection and to uplift the spirit.
safety_notes: Generally safe.

rituals.title: Joyous Pesto Ritual
rituals.description: A culinary ritual to invite abundance and joy into the home.
rituals.instructions: Hand-crush fresh basil leaves with oil and salt, focusing on the vibrant green color and uplifting scent.

name: Oregano

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Means 'Joy of the Mountain'; traditionally used for its cleansing properties.
safety_notes: Oil of oregano is very potent and should be used with caution.

rituals.title: Mountain Joy Infusion
rituals.description: A ritual to cleanse the palate and spirit.
rituals.instructions: Steep a small sprig of oregano in hot water. Sip slowly after a heavy meal.

name: Sage

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Kapha, increases Vata and Pitta

folk_wisdom: Associated with wisdom and long life; used for 'smudging' or clearing energy.
safety_notes: Avoid in large amounts during breastfeeding as it may reduce milk supply.

rituals.title: Wisdom Clearing
rituals.description: A ritual to clear mental fog and invite clarity.
rituals.instructions: Gently rub a fresh sage leaf between your fingers and inhale the scent before making an important decision.

name: Cloves

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Used traditionally for tooth comfort and as a warming digestive aid.
safety_notes: Very potent; use sparingly.

rituals.title: Spiced Hearth Warmth
rituals.description: A winter ritual to bring warmth to the center of the body.
rituals.instructions: Poke 3-5 whole cloves into an orange and keep it in your living space for a warming aroma.

name: Cardamom

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic)

folk_wisdom: The 'Queen of Spices'; used for its elegant aroma and digestive support.
safety_notes: Generally safe.

rituals.title: Clarity Pod Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to freshen the breath and clear the mind.
rituals.instructions: Gently chew on one green cardamom pod after a meal to support digestion and mental freshness.

name: Fennel

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic)

folk_wisdom: Believed to bestow strength and courage; widely used for digestive comfort.
safety_notes: Generally safe.

rituals.title: Sun-Kissed Sight Ritual
rituals.description: Traditionally associated with clarity of vision (both physical and mental).
rituals.instructions: Steep fennel seeds in hot water and use the steam to gently warm the face (eyes closed).

name: Star Anise

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Used in protective amulets and for its beautiful symmetry in seasonal rituals.
safety_notes: Ensure it is true Star Anise and not the toxic Japanese Star Anise.
contraindications: None known for true Star Anise in culinary amounts

rituals.title: Eight-Pointed Protection
rituals.description: A ritual to center oneself and invite protection.
rituals.instructions: Hold a whole star anise and count its eight points while breathing deeply to ground your energy.

name: Cumin

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic), especially good for Vata

folk_wisdom: Associated with fidelity and grounding; a staple for digestive fire.
safety_notes: Generally safe.

rituals.title: Agni Kindle Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to stoke the digestive fire (Agni).
rituals.instructions: Dry-toast cumin seeds until fragrant. Inhale the aroma before using them in a meal.

name: Coriander

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic), especially cooling for Pitta

folk_wisdom: Used in ancient Egypt; associated with peace and tranquility.
safety_notes: Generally safe.

rituals.title: Pitta-Cooling Infusion
rituals.description: A gentle ritual to balance heat in the body.
rituals.instructions: Soak coriander seeds in room-temperature water overnight. Strain and sip the water during a hot day.

name: Black Pepper

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: The 'Black Gold'; used to drive away cold and stimulate the internal fire.
safety_notes: Use sparingly if you have an active stomach ulcer.

rituals.title: Trikatu Fire Ritual
rituals.description: Part of the traditional Trikatu blend to awaken metabolism.
rituals.instructions: Add a pinch of freshly ground black pepper to warm water with ginger and honey before a heavy meal.

name: Cayenne Pepper

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Kapha, may increase Vata, strongly increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: Associated with quickening the blood and sparking transformation.
safety_notes: Avoid contact with eyes; very irritating to mucous membranes.

rituals.title: Circulation Spark
rituals.description: A ritual to warm the extremities during winter.
rituals.instructions: Add a tiny pinch of cayenne to your morning lemon water to 'wake up' the blood.

name: Saffron

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic)

folk_wisdom: The spice of joy and enlightenment; used to brighten the spirit.
safety_notes: Very expensive; a few threads are sufficient. Avoid large amounts in pregnancy.

rituals.title: Golden Spirit Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to invite happiness and mental clarity.
rituals.instructions: Soak 3-5 saffron threads in warm milk or water for 15 minutes. Sip while focusing on the color gold.

name: Rose

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta, may increase Kapha/Vata if cold

folk_wisdom: Symbol of love and the heart; used in traditional beauty and emotional rituals.
safety_notes: Ensure petals are food-grade and pesticide-free.

rituals.title: Heart-Opening Tea
rituals.description: A ritual to soothe the emotions and move stuck energy.
rituals.instructions: Steep dried rose buds in hot water. Inhale the floral scent deeply before every sip.

name: Elderberry

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: The 'Medicine Chest' of the common people; used for seasonal support.
safety_notes: Raw berries and other plant parts are toxic; must be cooked/processed.

rituals.title: Winter Gateway Syrup
rituals.description: A seasonal ritual to mark the beginning of the cold months.
rituals.instructions: Cook elderberries with honey and spices into a syrup. Take a spoonful daily during the winter solstice.

name: Echinacea

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha, may increase Vata

folk_wisdom: Native American tradition; used to bolster the body's resilience.
safety_notes: May cause a tingling sensation on the tongue (normal).

rituals.title: Root Resilience Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to honor the body's natural boundaries.
rituals.instructions: Steep echinacea root for 10-15 minutes. Sip while visualizing a protective field of energy around you.

name: Nettle

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha, may increase Vata

folk_wisdom: A powerful spring tonic; used to 'cleanse the blood' after winter.
safety_notes: Handle fresh leaves with gloves to avoid stings; stinging property is lost when dried or cooked.

rituals.title: Spring Renewal Infusion
rituals.description: A ritual to welcome the energy of spring.
rituals.instructions: Steep dried nettle leaves for at least 20 minutes to extract the minerals. Drink to feel the earth's vitality.

name: Dandelion

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha, increases Vata

folk_wisdom: The 'Lion's Tooth'; used to support the Liver and move stagnant energy.
safety_notes: Diuretic effect; ensure you stay hydrated.

rituals.title: Liver-Smoothing Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to release frustration and move Liver Qi.
rituals.instructions: Steep dandelion root or leaves. As you drink, visualize any 'stuck' emotions dissolving like dandelion seeds in the wind.

name: Licorice

meridians: All 12 meridians, especially Heart, Lung, Spleen, Stomach

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Pitta, may increase Kapha

folk_wisdom: The 'Great Harmonizer'; used to blend other herbs together and soothe the throat.
safety_notes: Avoid long-term use if you have high blood pressure.

rituals.title: Harmonizing Sip
rituals.description: A ritual to bring balance to a chaotic day.
rituals.instructions: Add a small piece of licorice root to any herbal tea. Focus on how it rounds out and sweetens the other flavors.

name: Ashwagandha

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, may increase Pitta

folk_wisdom: The 'Strength of a Horse'; used for grounding and restorative sleep.
safety_notes: May cause drowsiness; best taken in the evening.

rituals.title: Grounded Sleep Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to anchor the energy before bed.
rituals.instructions: Mix 1/2 tsp ashwagandha powder into warm milk with nutmeg. Drink slowly while feeling your weight sink into the earth.

name: Tulsi (Holy Basil)

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Kapha and Vata, may increase Pitta

folk_wisdom: The 'Incomparable One'; considered a sacred plant in India for clearing the mind and spirit.
safety_notes: Generally safe, but may have a mild blood-thinning effect.

rituals.title: Sacred Clarity Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to lift the 'fog' of daily stress.
rituals.instructions: Steep 5-7 fresh Tulsi leaves (or 1 tsp dried) in hot water. Inhale the spicy scent and focus on a single point of light.

name: Hibiscus

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha, increases Vata

folk_wisdom: Known for its vibrant red color; used in traditional cooling summer drinks.
safety_notes: Very tart; often needs a sweetener to balance.

rituals.title: Summer Cool-Down Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to release internal heat during hot days.
rituals.instructions: Brew hibiscus tea and let it cool. Add a slice of orange. Drink while visualizing a cool, gentle rain.

name: Green Tea

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha, increases Vata

folk_wisdom: A cornerstone of Asian wellness; used for mental alertness and longevity.
safety_notes: Contains caffeine; avoid late in the day if sensitive.

rituals.title: Mindful Morning Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to clarify the senses and gather the Qi.
rituals.instructions: Whisk or steep green tea leaves in water below boiling. Watch the leaves unfurl and take 3 deep breaths before sipping.

name: Apple Cider Vinegar

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha, increases Pitta

folk_wisdom: A traditional European 'cure-all'; used for digestion and skin rituals.
safety_notes: Always dilute before consuming or applying to skin.

rituals.title: Digestive Kindle Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to prepare the body for nourishment.
rituals.instructions: Mix 1 tsp of ACV in a cup of water. Drink 15 minutes before a meal to 'awaken' the stomach.

name: Coconut Oil

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Vata, increases Kapha (if in excess)

folk_wisdom: The 'Tree of Life'; used for its cooling and nourishing properties.
safety_notes: Highly stable for cooking at medium heat.

rituals.title: Oil Pulling Ritual
rituals.description: A traditional morning practice for oral and systemic clarity.
rituals.instructions: Swish 1 tbsp of coconut oil in the mouth for 10-15 minutes, then spit out (do not swallow).

name: Olive Oil

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata, may increase Pitta and Kapha (if in excess)

folk_wisdom: Sacred oil of the Mediterranean; symbol of peace and longevity.
safety_notes: Best used raw or at low heat to preserve delicate compounds.

rituals.title: Anointing Peace Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to calm the nerves and protect the skin.
rituals.instructions: Gently massage a few drops of olive oil into the hands or temples after a long day.

name: Sea Salt

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata, increases Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Used for purification and protection in almost every traditional culture.
safety_notes: Essential for life, but excess can lead to fluid retention.

rituals.title: Threshold Cleansing
rituals.description: A ritual to clear the energy of a space.
rituals.instructions: Sprinkle a tiny pinch of sea salt at the corners of a room or threshold to invite grounded energy.

name: Baking Soda

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Reduces Pitta (in very small amounts)

folk_wisdom: Used as a traditional alkalizing agent and for cleansing the home.
safety_notes: Use very sparingly internally; consult a professional first.

rituals.title: Foot Refresh Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to draw out tiredness from the feet.
rituals.instructions: Dissolve 2 tbsp of baking soda in a basin of warm water. Soak feet for 10 minutes.

name: Epsom Salt

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Named after the town in England; traditionally used for magnesium baths and relaxation.
safety_notes: For external use primarily; do not ingest without professional advice.

rituals.title: Starlight Soaking Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to release the day's tension.
rituals.instructions: Add 1 cup of Epsom salts to a warm bath. Soak for 20 minutes under dim light.

name: Rice

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic), especially white basmati

folk_wisdom: The foundation of life in many cultures; symbol of fertility and nourishment.
safety_notes: Generally safe for all.

rituals.title: Congee Comfort Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual for times of transition or recovery.
rituals.instructions: Cook 1 part rice in 6-8 parts water for several hours until it becomes a creamy porridge. Eat warm for grounding.

name: Oats

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Pitta, increases Kapha (if cooked with milk)

folk_wisdom: A traditional nervine; used to 'soothe the nerves' and provide steady energy.
safety_notes: Generally safe; use gluten-free oats if sensitive.

rituals.title: Nervine Nourishment
rituals.description: A ritual for times of overwhelm.
rituals.instructions: Slow-cook oats with a pinch of salt. Focus on the steady, grounding warmth of the bowl in your hands.

name: Flaxseed

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata, increases Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Used for its lubrication and grounding qualities; associated with the flow of life.
safety_notes: Best if ground fresh; consume with plenty of water.

rituals.title: Flow & Foundation Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to support inner movement and grounding.
rituals.instructions: Add 1 tbsp of ground flaxseeds to your morning meal. Visualize your body's systems moving with ease and grace.

name: Chia Seed

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Pitta, may increase Kapha

folk_wisdom: Used by Aztec warriors for endurance and hydration; known as 'strength' seeds.
safety_notes: Absorbs many times its weight in water; always soak before consuming large amounts.

rituals.title: Warrior's Endurance Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to build slow-release energy.
rituals.instructions: Soak chia seeds in water or juice for 20 minutes. Drink the 'gel' while setting an intention for steady progress.

name: Sesame Seed

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata, may increase Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Symbol of immortality in some traditions; used for grounding and bone support.
safety_notes: Black sesame is considered more potent for Kidney/Liver support in TCM.

rituals.title: Self-Anointing Warmth
rituals.description: A ritual to ground the Vata energy (using sesame oil).
rituals.instructions: Warm a small amount of sesame oil and massage it into the soles of your feet before sleep.

name: Goji Berry

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances all three doshas (Tridoshic)

folk_wisdom: Known as 'Red Diamonds'; used for longevity and bright eyes.
safety_notes: Generally safe; consume in moderate amounts.

rituals.title: Radiant Vision Steep
rituals.description: A ritual to nourish the Liver and brighten the eyes.
rituals.instructions: Add 10-15 goji berries to your tea. Once they are plump, eat them mindfully, focusing on visual clarity.

name: Jujube (Red Date)

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Pitta

folk_wisdom: The 'Date of Life'; used to nourish the blood and calm the mind.
safety_notes: Very sweet; use in moderation.
contraindications: Bloating or dampness in the body (in excess)

rituals.title: Heart-Calming Decoction
rituals.description: A ritual to settle the spirit after a busy day.
rituals.instructions: Simmer 3-5 red dates in water for 15 minutes. Drink the warm liquid and eat the dates to feel nourished.

name: Chrysanthemum

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Pitta, may increase Vata and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Symbol of nobility and autumn; used to 'clear heat' and brighten the eyes.
safety_notes: Use food-grade flowers only.

rituals.title: Golden Autumn Clearing
rituals.description: A ritual to release the day's heat and tension.
rituals.instructions: Steep 3-5 chrysanthemum flowers in hot water. Watch them float and imagine your mind becoming as clear as the tea.

name: Astragalus

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha

folk_wisdom: The 'Great Protector'; used to bolster the 'Upright Qi' or Wei Qi (protective energy).
safety_notes: Best used for long-term building, not during acute seasonal discomfort.

rituals.title: Wei Qi Shield Ritual
rituals.description: A ritual to strengthen your energetic boundaries.
rituals.instructions: Simmer astragalus root slices in your morning soup or tea. Visualize a golden shield of light around your body.

name: Ginseng

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata, increases Pitta and Kapha

folk_wisdom: The 'Root of Man'; used as a powerful tonic for vitality and resilience.
safety_notes: Very potent; avoid high doses or use with stimulants like caffeine.

rituals.title: Vitality Root Steep
rituals.description: A ritual for deep restoration.
rituals.instructions: Steep a few thin slices of ginseng in hot water. Sip slowly, focusing on the root's connection to the earth's deep power.

name: Valerian

ayurvedic_properties.dosha: Balances Vata and Kapha

folk_wisdom: Known for its strong, earthy scent; used in traditional sleep and calming rituals.
safety_notes: The smell is very distinct and earthy; some find it unpleasant.

rituals.title: Deep Root Rest
rituals.description: A ritual to descend into deep, earthy sleep.
rituals.instructions: Steep valerian root for 10 minutes before bed. Inhale the grounding scent and let your body feel heavy like the root.
